scope: Home nearby entry, themed photo cards, preferences, Leaflet map, place details and external directions
map: Leaflet 1.9.4 (local JS/CSS) + OpenStreetMap tiles with attribution
preferences: localStorage keys-nearby-interests-v1; separate nearby interests, initial demo culture/walk/food
travelTimes: Illustrative estimates, not a routing API. UI explicitly labels them approximate. Live route opened in Yandex Maps.
externalDependencies: Map tiles require internet; photo cards, filters, preferences and detail screens are local. Tile error state provides a route/list fallback.
